Job Description:
This opportunity is with one of the leading payment modernisation firms, working on a mission-critical program focused on building real-time, high-volume, low-latency transaction systems powered by AI and cloud-native architectures. You will be part of the founding engineering team, setting the benchmark for future AI-driven systems.

Key Responsibilities:
Design and build agentic AI solutions using LangChain, LangGraph, and RAG.
Develop LLM-powered workflows and intelligent automation systems.
Build Python-based microservices and orchestration layers.
Implement vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval systems.
Deploy and optimize AI systems in production environments.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve real-world business problems using AI.
Required Technical Skills:
Strong hands-on experience in Python (mandatory).
1 2+ years of real-world experience in GenAI / LLM-based systems.
Expertise in RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases.
Experience with LangChain / LangGraph or similar frameworks.
Good understanding of system design and scalable architectures.
Exposure to AWS or similar cloud platforms.
Hiring Process:
2 3 technical rounds.
Fast-track evaluation for strong profiles.
 
Additional Information:
Experience: 4-8 Years.
Open Positions: 2.
Compensation: Based on experience.
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days preferred.
